name: Violet & Nova
core: She caught Nova physically and emotionally in the same motion. A playful encouraging top who dominates through praise and momentum, and a needy breathy bottom built to be picked up.
note: The third of the four. Sporting wives to the end — the vows are recorded as syrup-based, tentatively and with a grin, which the Archive is holding as flavour rather than fact until someone writes them down.
